backend/main.mo: Defines types and core logic for user profiles, tool listings, and rental requests with authentication and access control. Includes sorting helpers and state management for profiles, tools, and rentals.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping implemented features to related files, components, and tests. Used for tracking feature completion and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains short summaries of specific frontend pages, noting their purpose and recent fixes. Serves as documentation for ListingFormPage and RentalDetailPage.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and base styles for light and dark modes. Applies global background, foreground, and border styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point that loads the React app via main.tsx and mounts it in the root div. Provides page metadata and title.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the React Router configuration and routes for all major pages. Wraps the app with theming and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and error handling. Clears cached queries on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Wraps protected content and shows a sign‑in prompt when the user is unauthenticated. Uses Internet Identity login flow.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Simple footer component showing copyright and a link to caffeine.ai. Uses Tailwind for layout and styling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Responsive header with navigation, authentication controls, and a mobile menu. Shows additional links when a user is authenticated.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Layout wrapper placing the header, footer, and main content structure. Ensures consistent page framing across the app.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: Filter bar component providing search, category, price range, availability toggle, and sorting controls for tool listings.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Displays a grid of tool listing cards with images, pricing, category, condition, and links to individual listing pages.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: Provides listing owners with edit and availability toggle actions via a dropdown menu.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: Manages a list of photo URL inputs, allowing users to add, preview, and remove images.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: User profile menu offering display info, profile editing, and logout, with an editable dialog form.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Shows a required profile setup dialog for new authenticated users to enter basic profile details.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: Form for submitting rental requests with date validation and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: UI component providing owners and renters with status update actions for a rental, including approval, decline, and cancellation flows with confirmations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, identity persistence, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, tools, searches, rentals, and other backend data via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup and theme definitions establishing color tokens and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, and Internet Identity provider before rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Page for browsing tool listings with filters and sorting, powered by the search tools query.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and feature highlights, offering navigation to browse or authenticate to list tools.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a tool listing, including photos, availability, owner actions, and rental request form.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: Provides a create/edit form for tool listings with field validation and submission via add or edit listing mutations.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Shows all rentals made by the user with status badges and links to rental and tool details.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Lists all tools owned by the user with options to add new listings or manage existing ones.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific rental, including tool data, dates, status, cost, and available actions for owner or renter.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Shows incoming rental requests for the user's tools with status indicators and links to details and tool pages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL params (including hash routes), storing/retrieving them in sessionStorage, and persisting values across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, version info, and a list of implemented features for a garage‑tool rental marketplace.
